item.title: Peyton basketball wins again 58-46 over TCA
item.description: (PEYTON, Colo.) — Peyton basketball (16-3) won its 11th game in its last dozen contests 58-46 over The Classical Academy (13-7) on Tuesday night. The Panthers will next host Evangel Christian Academy on Thursday night, February 19.
